title: Money Matters When TTC
summary: Trying to conceive can be expensive, especially if you’re going through IVF and/or IUI. Learn more about insurance coverage and government subsidies to lessen your financial load.
body_markdown:
Table of Contents


- Let’s Talk Finances
- I’m Getting Pregnant In: Singapore
- I’m Getting Pregnant In: The United Kingdom


Having a baby is an exciting and life-changing event, but it also requires careful financial planning and preparation.


Whether you're based in Singapore or the U.K., you’ll find the information below useful in optimizing your TTC budget.


## Let’s Talk Finances


**To ensure a smooth and stress-free journey toward parenthood, discover how you can make the most of your resources and prepare for your future with Junior.**


- [Should You Still Try To Get Pregnant While In A Recession?](https://blog.twoplusfertility.com/blogs/pregnancy/get-pregnant-during-recession)
- Are You Financially Prepared To Have a Baby?
- Having a Baby Is More Costly Than You Think — We Break Down the Numbers


## I’m Getting Pregnant In: Singapore


In Singapore, there are governmental policies in place to help make these expenses more manageable for families like you. By taking advantage of these resources, you can focus on the joy of starting a family without being overwhelmed by financial stress.


[Best Fertility Treatments & IVF Insurance in Singapore](https://blog.twoplusfertility.com/blogs/fertility/insurance-fertility-treatments-singapore)[How Much Does IVF Cost in Singapore?](https://singaporelegaladvice.com/law-articles/in-vitro-fertilization-ivf-singapore-procedure-cost/)


[Can I Claim Medisave for IVF in Singapore?](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/infohub/educational-resources/what-can-i-do-with-my-medisave)


[What Budget 2023 Means for Singaporeans Trying To Conceive](https://blog.seedly.sg/baby-bonus-parenthood-tax-rebate-more-perks-for-making-babies/)


## I’m Getting Pregnant In: The United Kingdom


The cost of having a baby or undergoing fertility treatments can vary widely depending on the country you’re in.


Learn more about the policies and plans in the United Kingdom to help you budget for a new addition to the family.


- [How Much Does IVF Cost in the UK?](https://fertilityroad.com/ivf/ivf-costs-uk-revealed/)


- [Can IVF Be Covered Under Health Insurance in the UK?](https://www.onlinemoneyadvisor.co.uk/insurance/health-insurance/private-health-insurance-ivf/)
- [What Fertility Tests Can Be Done on the NHS in the UK?](https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/ivf/getting-started/)
